name: RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL
description: The RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL table stores interface information for each invoice line that AutoInvoice imports into Oracle Receivables. The primary key for this table is INTERFACE_LINE_ID.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Interface line identifier.

columns.name: ENF_SEQ_DATE_CORRELATION_CODE

columns.name: BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Batch transaction source.  Use the Manage Transaction Sources task to identify valid values.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier.  Use the Manage Primary Ledgers task to find valid ledger identifiers.  If left blank, defaults from system options for the business unit.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction line type. Valid values: LINE, TAX, FREIGHT, and CHARGES.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Transaction line description. Mandatory. Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code.  Use the Manage Currencies task to identify valid values.  Use the three character ISO currency code. Example: US Dollars is USD.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction line amount.  Do not use thousand separators. Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator. Mandatory if the LINE_TYPE is LINE and the line isn''t only for freight or tax.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name. Use the Manage Transaction Types task to identify valid values.  Credit memos must use a credit memo transaction type name.  Use either CUST_TRX_TYPE_NAME or CUST_TRX_TYPE_ID, but not both.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier.  Use the Manage Transaction Types task to identify valid values.  Credit memos must use a credit memo transaction type name.

columns.name: TERM_NAME
columns.description: Payment term name.  Use the Manage Receivables Payment Terms task to identify valid values.  Use either TERM_NAME or TERM_ID, but not both.  Do not use for credit memos or on-account credits.

columns.name: TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier.  Use the Manage Receivables Payment Terms task to find valid values.  Use either TERM_NAME or TERM_ID, but not both.   Do not use for credit memos or on-account credits.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Original system batch name for grouping transactions. Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_REF
columns.description: Original system bill-to customer.  Use the Manage Customers taskpane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_ID or ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_REF, but not both.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Original system bill-to customer identifier.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_ID or ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CUSTOMER_REF, but not both.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_REF
columns.description: Original system bill-to address reference.  Use the Manage Customers taskpane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.    Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_REF or ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_ID, but not both.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if freight the line is for freight.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Original system bill-to customer address identifier.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_REF or ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_ADDRESS_ID, but not both.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if freight the line is for freight.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CONTACT_REF
columns.description: Original system billing contact reference.  Use the Manage Customers taskpane in Billing to identify valid values.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CONTACT_REF or ORIG_SYSTEM_BILL_CONTACT_ID, but not both.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if freight the line is for freight.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_REF
columns.description: Original system shipping contact reference.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_REF or ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_ID, but not both.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if freight the line is for freight.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Original system shipping contact identifier.  Use either ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_REF or ORIG_SYSTEM_SHIP_CONTACT_ID, but not both.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if freight the line is for freight.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_SOLD_CUSTOMER_REF

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Receipt method name.  Use Manage Receipt Classes and Methods task to identify valid values.  Must be a receipt method associated with the customer.  Use either RECEIPT_METHOD_NAME or RECEIPT_METHOD_ID, but not both.

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Receipt method identifier.  Use Manage Receipt Classes and Methods task to identify valid values.  Must be a receipt method associated with the customer.  Use either RECEIPT_METHOD_NAME or RECEIPT_METHOD_ID, but not both.

columns.name: CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type.  Required if CONVERSION_TYPE is User defined or if the line currency code is the same as the ledger currency.  Use Manage Conversion Rate Types task to identify valid values. To provide a conversion rate for the line use: User.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Conversion rate date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  If NULL, TRANSACTION_DATE is used as the exchange rate date.  Do not use if the CURRENCY_CODE is the same as the ledger currency used to account for the line.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate.  Required if CURRENCY_CODE value is different than the ledger currency used to account for the line and/or the CONVERSION_TYPE is User.   If the CURRENCY_CODE is the same as the ledger currency use: 1.00.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Transaction identifier.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  Do not use if TRX_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  Must be in an open or future enterable accounting period.  Do not use if the Post To option for the associated transaction type is set to No, or if LINE_TYPE is TAX or FREIGHT.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction document number.  Used if automatic transaction numbering option on the transaction batch source is disabled.  Do not use if the LINE_TYPE is TAX or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number.  Must be unique by transaction source.  Do not use if TRX_TYPE is TAX or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Line number.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of units shipped, or number of the units on a credit memo.  Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator.  For debit memos with LINE_TYPE of CHARGES, use: 1.  For credit memos with LINE_TYPE of LINE, and CREDIT_METHOD_FOR_ACCT_RULE of UNIT, valid values: 1, -1.

columns.name: QUANTITY_ORDERED
columns.description: Original number of units ordered for the transaction.  Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator. Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, the line is for freight, or for credit memos.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit. Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator.  Do not use if the LINE_TYPE is tax, if the line is for freight, or for credit memos.

columns.name: UNIT_STANDARD_PRICE
columns.description: Standard unit price.  Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator.

columns.name: PRINTING_OPTION
columns.description: Printing option.  Use Manage Receivables lookups, lookup type INVOICE_PRINTING_OPTION to identify valid values.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Interface status.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RELATED_BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Batch source of the transaction document.   Use Manage Transaction Sources task to identify valid values.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or if the line is for freight.  Do not use for on-account credits or credit memos.

columns.name: RELATED_TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Document number to which this transaction is related.  Must be an existing transaction number in Oracle Fusion Receivables.

columns.name: RELATED_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Customer transaction identifier of the transaction-related document.  Use Manage Transactions task to identify valid values.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Previous customer transaction identifier.

columns.name: CREDIT_METHOD_FOR_ACCT_RULE
columns.description: Credit method for crediting a transaction that uses an accounting rule.  Valid values: PRORATE, UNIT, LIFO.  Last In first out (LIFO) backs out revenue starting with the last general ledger period and reverses all prior periods until it has used up the credit memo.Prorate credits an equal percentage to all account assignments for this invoice.Unit reverses the revenue for the number of units you specify from an original line of the invoice. Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or CHARGES, or for header freight charges.

columns.name: CREDIT_METHOD_FOR_INSTALLMENTS
columns.description: Credit method for crediting a transaction that uses split payment terms.  Valid values: PRORATE, LIFO, or FIFO or NULL.   First in first out (FIFO) credits the first installment first. Last in first out (LIFO) credits the last installment first.  Prorate credits the installments of the credited transaction and prorates them based on the amount remaining for each installment.   Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or CHARGES, or when passing header freight charges.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Transaction line reason code.  Use the Manage Receivables lookup task, lookup type INVOICING_REASON or CREDIT_MEMO_REASON to identify valid values.   Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or for freight charges.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate.  If LINE_TYPE is TAX you must enter a value for either this or the AMOUNT column.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is LINE, CHARGES, or FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax code.  Mandatory if LINE_TYPE is TAX.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is CHARGES or FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX_PRECEDENCE
columns.description: Tax line precedence number.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is LINE, CHARGES, or FREIGHT, or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Tax exception identifier.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Tax exemption identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_DATE_ACTUAL
columns.description: Shipment date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or for freight.

columns.name: FOB_POINT
columns.description: Freight on Board Point.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or for freight.  Not validated.

columns.name: SHIP_VIA
columns.description: Ship via code.   Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, for freight, or for credit memos.  Not validated.

columns.name: WAYBILL_NUMBER
columns.description: Waybill number.  Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: INVOICING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Invoicing rule name.  Valid values: In Advance, In Arrears. Mandatory for lines with invoicing rules.  Use either INVOICING_RULE_ID or INVOICING_RULE_NAME, but not both.

columns.name: INVOICING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Invoicing rule identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule name. Use the Manage Revenue Scheduling Rules task to identify valid values.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Accounting rule identifier.  Use Manage Revenue Scheduling Rules task to identify valid values.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or CHARGES, or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule duration.  Do not use for credit memos, on-account credits or if the LINE_TYPE is TAX or CHARGES.  Positive integers only.

columns.name: RULE_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue sharing rule start date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  Must be earlier or equal to RULE_END_DATE.  Do not use for credit memos.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SALESREP_NUMBER
columns.description: Primary salesperson number. Mandatory if the Require Salesrep option is yes.  Use Manage Resources task, role Salesperson to identify valid values.  Use either PRIMARY_SALESREP_NUMBER or PRIMARY_SALESREP_ID, but not both.   Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX or CHARGES, or if the line is for freight.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SALESREP_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Primary salesrep identifier.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER
columns.description: Sales order number.    Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.  Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE
columns.description: Sales order line number.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.  Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: Sales order date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE
columns.description: Sales order source.  Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_REVISION
columns.description: Sales order revision number.  Free text field.  Not validated.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER
columns.description: Transaction purchase order number.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.  Do not use for credit memos.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER_REVISION
columns.description: Purchase order revision number.  Use only if PURCHASE_ORDER is populated.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.  Do not use for credit memos.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: Purchase order date.  Date format: RR/MM/DD.  Use only if PURCHASE_ORDER is populated.  Do not use if LINE_TYPE is TAX, or if the line is for freight.  Do not use for credit memos.
